layout.global_structure: 3-column fixed-sidebar layout (Left Sidebar: 240px, Main: Fluid, Right Sidebar: 280px). On mobile, sidebars collapse into a bottom nav or hamburger menu.
layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-6 for cards, gap-6 for video grids. Main content wrapper needs px-6 sm:px-10 py-8.
layout.video_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout.radius: rounded-lg for video thumbnails, rounded-md for buttons/inputs, rounded-xl for modals.

components.video_card: Group wrapper. Thumbnail: aspect-video, overflow-hidden, rounded-lg. Image: object-cover w-full h-full transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105. Overlay: bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center (Play icon). Below: Flex container with uploader avatar (h-10 w-10 rounded-full) and text block (title line-clamp-2, views, time ago).
components.left_sidebar: Fixed h-screen w-[240px] border-r border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar. Links are flex items, px-4 py-3 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-50 hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors.
components.right_sidebar: Fixed h-screen w-[280px] right-0 border-l border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar. Contains User Profile mini-card, Pro Upgrade CTA with pro_gradient background or border, and Recommended Videos list (compact mode).
components.header: Fixed top-0 left-[240px] right-[280px] h-16 border-b border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl z-40 px-6 flex items-center justify-between. Search bar centered.
components.pro_cta: Card with subtle gradient border (Tracing Beam style). Inner bg zinc-900. Bright rose-500 button.
components.video_player: Responsive wrapper aspect-video bg-black rounded-lg overflow-hidden relative. Custom controls overlay at bottom (Tailwind styled). Resolution picker dropdown.
components.announcement_modal: Centered Dialog. Backdrop blur-sm bg-black/60. Content box bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-8 max-w-md text-center. High impact.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links must always change text color and background. hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-50.
motion_and_interactions.video_hover: Subtle scale-105 on the image thumbnail, fade in black/40 overlay with play button.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion fade in for main content areas.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Initialize a React application with Vite, install Tailwind CSS, framer-motion, lucide-react, and Shadcn UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create the 3-column layout structure in App.js (or main layout component) early on, as all pages share this structure.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, dialogs (for announcements), dropdowns (for resolution picker and admin menus).
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The right sidebar has different states based on auth. If logged out, show Login/Register buttons. If logged in, show User Profile snippet.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Admin dashboard should use the same dark theme but adopt the 'Control Room' grid (tight gap-4, metrics at the top, data tables below).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-video-button', data-testid='pro-upgrade-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use 'Inter' font. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body. Configure this in tailwind.config.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Use the provided dummy video and profile images as placeholders in the UI before real backend integration.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: The video player should be styled nicely. Since FFmpeg backend is required for resolution switching, the frontend player needs a custom dropdown to switch source URLs based on the selected resolution.
